author: raymond91125
body:
[Written by Claude]

Dear all,

The proposal has been made to obsolete **GO:1903608 | protein localization to cytoplasmic stress granule**
see geneontology/go-ontology#32318

There are **8 EXP annotations** (2 IDA, 6 IMP) that need review. They are listed below with recommended
actions. A curator review (see #32318) found that none support an `involved_in` claim for a
protein-localization *process*: 7/8 are co-localization / stress-granule-component evidence (→ at most
`located_in GO:0010494 cytoplasmic stress granule`) and 1/8 (PAK1) is an unsupported mechanistic
over-interpretation. The term's sole definition xref (PMID:24755092) does not describe a localization
process or even mention stress granules.

**Annotations to review + recommended actions:**

| Gene | UniProt | Qualifier | Ev | Ref | Assigned by | Recommended action | Rationale |
|------|---------|-----------|----|-----|-------------|--------------------|-----------|
| DDX3X | O00571 | involved_in | IMP | PMID:24965446 | AgBase | remove | Npro interactor / SG component; not shown to localize a protein. Component → `located_in GO:0010494` |
| SSB (La) | P05455 | involved_in | IDA | PMID:24965446 | AgBase | remove | Relocates nucleus→cytoplasmic granules *with* Npro (cargo, co-loc) → `located_in GO:0010494` |
| TIA1 | P31483 | involved_in | IMP | PMID:24965446 | AgBase | remove | Canonical SG nucleator/marker; component → `located_in GO:0010494` |
| YBX1 | P67809 | involved_in | IMP | PMID:24965446 | AgBase | remove | Binds Npro TRASH domain; SG component (co-loc) → `located_in GO:0010494` |
| DHX9 | Q08211 | involved_in | IMP | PMID:24965446 | AgBase | remove | Relocates nucleus→cytoplasmic granules *with* Npro (cargo, co-loc) → `located_in GO:0010494` |
| DDX1 | Q92499 | involved_in | IMP | PMID:24965446 | AgBase | remove | Part of SG, but not shown in paper to localize a protein → `located_in GO:0010494` |
| DCP1A | Q9NPI6 | involved_in | IMP | PMID:24965446 | AgBase | remove | Decapping factor; P-body/SG component → `located_in GO:0010494` |
| PAK1 | Q13153 | involved_in | IDA | PMID:20417602 | UniProt | remove | Kinase; phosphorylates FXR1 Ser420, phospho-signal rises when fragile X proteins are recruited to SG. Correlative only — paper states mechanism unresolved. No CC replacement (PAK1 not a SG component) |

Note on the AgBase set (PMID:24965446, Jefferson et al. 2014, J Virol): this is a mass-spec interactome +
co-localization study of the *viral* protein Npro. The 6 IMP codes also appear misapplied — there is no
mutant-phenotype evidence for these host proteins in the paper.

**Impacted groups:**

- **AgBase** — 7 annotations (all PMID:24965446): @Antonialock @pgaudet @vanaukenk  (AgBase not actively maintained → GO Central)
- **UniProt** — 1 annotation (PMID:20417602, PAK1): @Antonialock

** Group contacts: https://github.com/geneontology/go-site/blob/master/metadata/group-contacts.csv

----

Mappings that need to be reviewed: (InterPro2GO, UniProt-Keywords, UniRule)
None (per #32318).

Thanks.
